name: ai-games-kit
description: Ship the game, not AI slop: Claude Code agents + skills + scripts for building, polishing, exporting and marketing web games.

scripts.demo:serve: node -e "require('http').createServer((q,r)=>{const f=require('path').join('examples/offcut',q.url.split('?')[0]==='/'?'index.html':q.url.split('?')[0]);require('fs').readFile(f,(e,d)=>{if(e){r.writeHead(404);return r.end()}r.writeHead(200,{'content-type':f.endsWith('.js')?'text/javascript':f.endsWith('.woff2')?'font/woff2':'text/html'});r.end(d)})}).listen(8080,()=>console.log('OFF-CUT on http://localhost:8080  (add ?bot=1 to watch the autoplayer)'))"
